summary: Correct the additional distribution reference to 89/127
rationale: The quoted sentence itself is correctly cited at 86/16. The additional reference 89/128 contains only W rišayxu howe basimo, the closing blessing. The immediately preceding verse 89/127 has the relevant additional distribution occurrence: aḥ=ḥamməšmo=waroqe mfarqənne ʕal ḥḏoḏe l at=taḥarriye. Correct the extra reference while retaining 86/16.
The counterfactual clause requires wäre; the supplied edition also reads gewesen wäre.
